public_definitions: Review the monthly energy dashboard and decide whether May should be handled as a standard low-output case or escalated as a critical low-output anomaly.
Use the dashboard record for May as the evidence source for deciding whether its low output should remain on standard follow-up or be escalated as a critical anomaly.
The decision is between: Route May to standard low-output follow-up, Escalate May to critical low-output anomaly review, or Send May to background monthly record filing.
